Any vaginal bleeding during pregnancy is a critical emergency red flag that requires immediate hospital evaluation. Whether the bleeding is light spotting or heavy bleeding, and whether it comes with abdominal cramps or is completely painless, you must not stay at home or wait to see if it stops. Never discard colostrum or give concoctions, sugar water, or teas; colostrum gives your newborn the perfect start to life.
